fail_closed_rules: Planned, executed and failed statuses are distinct; a plan is not an execution receipt.
Credential-shaped fields and values are prohibited from packets.
Scenario controls are fixed and must match the declared scenario.
Failed exercises remain preserved and require a new successor packet after remediation.
Execution reports bind every required control to passed, failed or not-run.
Hosted execution requires a hosted run identifier and a raw-log SHA-256 digest.
Execution reports remain non-assertive until factual review and the applicable release gate are complete.
non_claims: This contract does not exercise a real credential, deployment or production rollback.
Agent-panel assessment cannot substitute for factual security execution evidence.
